snippet.title: Pharma R&D Manager: Tutorial Video - How to play the game?
snippet.description:
More information on: https://pharma-game.com
The Game is available on Microsoft Store, STEAM and Apple App Store.

The Pharma R&D Pipeline Manager Game is an educational business and management simulation. Players will immerse themselves in the dynamic management world of pharmaceutical research & development, navigating the challenging journey from initial discovery through clinical development to final regulatory approval.

Dive into the dynamic world of pharmaceuticals with this interactive, round-based business simulation game. Gain valuable insights into the success probabilities of R&D phases, navigate business development strategies, and overcome financial challenges. You’ll also learn how leadership skills and a strong organizational culture are vital for fostering employee engagement, boosting organizational effectiveness, and achieving overall success.

Though a simplified model, this game is designed to challenge your strategic thinking and provide an engaging learning experience. We invite you to play, learn, and have fun!

This Tutorial video introduces you to the gameplay. Visit https://pharma-game.com for more details.
